# Peanut Butter Fish Lessons

> > Homeschool unit studies and printable educational materials designed by Randi Smith to engage struggling learners through thematic, cross-curricular learning.

Peanut Butter Fish Lessons offers curated unit studies covering history, science, and literature topics, along with free resources and a shop of educational products. The site serves homeschooling families seeking structured, engaging curriculum materials.

## Key Topics

- Unit Studies
- Homeschool Resources
- Randi Smith
- Printable Materials
- Free Materials
- Magic Tree House
- Struggling Learners
- Educational Products
- Mini Unit Studies
- Vocabulary Cards
- Learning Activities
- Geography
- Number Sense
- Homeschool Organization
